reason: A text scan: it reads adapter-sql.ts and index.ts from disk and compares their SQL text with literals, so it executes no mutated source. Stryker instruments those files before the tests run, so the comparison cannot hold there; jest.stryker.config.ts ignores the spec for that reason. The SQL text itself is asserted by the builders spec, which the mutation run does execute.

It runs a bundled copy of the absorb helper in a separate node process: the bundle is built from the files on disk, so inside the mutation run it would bundle the instrumented source and fail every mutant, and it executes no mutated source of its own. jest.stryker.config.ts ignores the spec for that reason. The helper's behaviour with a throwing logger is asserted in-process by host-call-failures.spec.ts, which the mutation run does execute.
